lock_effect: Locking makes the explored settings permanent on fleet-boards: stale-treatment = quiet; density = --space-4. Until then nothing has changed — exploration never applies.

mutations.change: Stale rows drop to the muted offline treatment (ground --panel-2, text --muted) with the age printed and a gold tick in --accent; conflict red becomes blocked-only, and a row both stale and blocked renders as blocked with its age still printed.
Set the board cluster gap to 1rem (ladder step --space-4); touch targets do not shrink at any step.

summary: Explored via tweaks manifest 'boards-exploration': stale-treatment = quiet; density = --space-4.
